name: Routing — static vs dynamic model discovery
summary: Documentation card: the difference between a connection with a static models[] array vs one with a modelDiscovery endpoint.
description: Both forms produce identical on-wire behavior — you still call '{conn}/{model}'. The difference is whether Foundry validates the model name at agent-creation time by inspecting connection metadata (static) or by calling GET {target}{listModelsEndpoint} (dynamic). The functional probes are prompt-agents-{static,dynamic}.
